game.name: Dynasty Warriors : Gundam 3 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Dynasty Warriors: Gundam 3 on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all in the tradition of the famous Koei series. Featuring a new cel-shaded graphical look, the title welcomes new mechas and an online cooperative mode. It also allows us to summon assistants in battle or customise our robots in great detail.
